name: app-food-ordering-arc-menu-in-hands-thumbnail
title: Food ordering app close-up as a project thumbnail
whatItIs: A small-format crop of the food app in both hands showing the arc category selector, product cards and floating black nav.
whatItMeans: Compact and legible; the hands and large UI read even at thumbnail size.
techniques: Crop tightly so the main title and food images dominate.
Keep the surroundings a soft peach gradient.
Use the pill nav at the bottom as an anchor.
Let the finger point at a card for a sense of action.

vocabulary.definition: A recomposed image sized for small display.
A bottom bar that grounds the composition.
A finger touching the UI in a photo.
